title: 客单价
question: 2026年8月杭州的客单价
sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov
FROM orders AS o
JOIN stores AS s
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND s.city = '杭州'
LIMIT 1000
